sources.title: California Secretary of State, Statement of Vote, November 8, 2022 General Election: United States Senator (Partial/Unexpired Term) by county (xlsx)
California Secretary of State, Statement of Vote, November 8, 2022 General Election (index)

method: pipeline/patches/2022_CA_SEN_special.py reads the county rows of the Statement of Vote partial-term Senate table (xlsx, PDF copy kept alongside) and maps county names to FIPS; only Padilla (DEM) and Meuser (REP) were on this contest, with no write-in candidates listed, so oth is 0.
validation: CSV statewide dem 6,559,308 / rep 4,212,450 / oth 0 vs certified Statement of Vote State Totals Padilla 6,559,308 / Meuser 4,212,450: difference 0 / 0 (0.00%).
